parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.location, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.reminder_sent, a.conversation_id, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.id as contact_id, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name, b.timezone AS business_timezone
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN contacts c ON a.contact_id = c.id
  JOIN businesses b ON b.id = c.business_id
 WHERE a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')
   AND a.starts_at > NOW()
   AND a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
   AND COALESCE(a.metadata #>> ARRAY['reminders',
        CASE
          WHEN a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN '2h'
          WHEN a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '24h'
          ELSE '48h'
        END], '') = ''
 ORDER BY a.starts_at ASC
 LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, business_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT NULLIF($1, '')::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $2, $3, COALESCE((SELECT business_id FROM conversations WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid), (SELECT id FROM businesses LIMIT 1)), NOW(), NOW() RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
   SET metadata = jsonb_set(COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb), '{reminders}',
         COALESCE(metadata->'reminders', '{}'::jsonb) ||
           jsonb_build_object($2::text, jsonb_build_object('status', 'sent', 'sent_at', NOW())), true),
       reminder_sent = TRUE,
       updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid
 RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('appointment', NULLIF($1, '')::uuid, 'reminder_sent', 'system', 'automation', $2, jsonb_build_object('reminder_type', $3), jsonb_build_object('appointment_title', $4, 'contact_id', NULLIF($5, '')::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;
